static_review.postposed_bounds: The existing shared finite qualifier grammar now includes 不到/不止/开外 and selected traditional aliases. Source and quote guards inspect attached edges across layout; punctuation and other people do not attach.
static_review.named_arithmetic: A bounded 2–16 Han-character name ending in 系数/系數/比例 is admitted only on explicit arithmetic/multiplier/fraction paths; single-character operator exclusions retain 加班/加薪/减免/减薪/除外/除了 prose.
static_review.traditional_numeral: 萬 is recognized by token detection and folded only on the strict parsing copy; original rawValue, matched text and code-point spans remain original. This does not add general 兩/億 precise parsing.
static_review.ordinary_yuan: Shared finite lexical predicates guard 二/2元论(論) and 三/3元催化器/剂/劑, including clipped bare numbers and neighboring-block continuation, while genuine yuan wage amounts are controls.
static_review.subject_exception: Only the currency guard receives candidate.subject. Exemption requires a single common surname plus complete currency literal/code, a unique preceding complete same-clause original span, and finite surrounding boundaries. Parentheses replace the span so a separate foreign marker remains attached. Currency-only or prose-containing model subjects are not trusted.
static_review.history: Source review only lowers availability when an existing amount was non-null; historical null/unsupported is not upgraded by new numeral or subject handling.

coverage_limits: Synthetic finite contracts and source review are distinct from legal or real-case correctness. No legal expert endorsement is claimed.

A candidate accepted into review is distinct from an exact amount being available; an exact derived amount is distinct from calculation authorization. Every tested runtime state remains unconfirmed and non-calculable.
The surname/currency shape is a conservative lexical exception, not identity authentication. Complex, unmatched or ambiguous subjects may remain unavailable.
This is not a general Chinese word segmenter or unrestricted symbolic expression parser; unlisted word families and semantics remain outside the five finding contracts.

All six scoring layers are checked on a two-event traditional/simplified equal-amount synthetic case. The scorer, ingest occurrence dedup and frozen benchmark outputs were not changed or re-evaluated in this product-only review.
The reviewer did not execute HTTP, full npm check, remote CI, a model request, deployment or human acceptance. Those evidence classes must be recorded separately by the integrator.
Requested reviewer configuration is GPT-6.1 Sol ultra; actual backend/runtime configuration is not independently verifiable from this agent.
